text.en:
13th. OCTOBER, 2004 No. S 71

CORRIGENDUM

CURRENCY AND MONETARY ORDER, 2004 (S 16/04) In this Order, published in No. 5 of Part II of the Government Gazette dated 12th. February, 2004, in subsection (2) of section 4, at page 227 in the English text, the word "or" should read as "of". ·'
